item.title: Sip your way through Milwaukee: Wine bars worth exploring
item.description: From cozy neighborhood gems to stylish sip spots, these wine bars deliver by the glass, flight or bottle.

item.title: First Look: Tabletop Bookshelf
item.description: Part indie bookstore, part indie game shop, Tabletop Bookshelf opened this weekend in Walker's Point.

item.title: Brewers shuttle guide
item.description: Looking to get to a Brewers game this season without having to navigate the stadium traffic? Here are the shuttles that will get you to American Family Field with ease.

item.title: Thank Cod it's Fryday: 10 bars that serve up a mighty good fish fry
item.description: There are just two more fish fry Fridays left before Easter, so you might as well do it up right.

item.title: Hustling Sideways Podcast with Katlyn Putney of Wisconsin W Sports
item.description: This week on Hustling Sideways, we explore the evolving landscape of high school sports, the importance of promoting girls' participation, and the innovative efforts of Wisconsin W Sports to increase visibility and support for female athletes.

item.title: The Outlaw Music Festival is coming to Alpine Valley Music Theatre this summer
item.description: The 11th run of the touring festival will make their way to East Troy, with the lineup announcement coming on Tuesday morning.

item.title: Urban spelunking: Erhard Stoettner's stained glass at Von Trier
item.description: Since buying the bar a year ago, John Dye has been busily chipping away at a list of updates and repairs, most of which have been so subtle that customers may not have even noticed. Now he's turning his attention to the stained glass windows created by master craftsman Erhard Stoettner at T.C. Esser.

item.title: County seeks a developer for 1-acre site at 10th and Highland
item.description: The RFP seeks qualified developers to purchase and redevelop a 1.07-acre site at 933 W. Highland Ave. that has been home to the Medical Examiner's Office since May 1989.

item.title: Kokoro Cafe pop-ups bring heartfelt taste of Japan to Milwaukee bars
item.description: A hospitality veteran is using pop-ups to share authentic flavors and, perhaps, build something even bigger.

item.title: Sip the collection: Mason Street Grill pours art-inspired cocktails
item.description: A limited-time menu invites guests to sip their way through the iconic art collection at The Pfister Hotel.

item.title: A surefire sign of spring: Nite Owl Drive-in has reopened for the season
item.description: Be sure to note the operating hours for this South Side burger stop!

item.title: Old Guard Games hosts AdeptiCon pre-party, celebs, free shuttle, meetups, more
item.description: Headed to AdeptiCon this weekend? Check out Old Guard Games at the convention and in their extraordinary shop on Milwaukee's East Side.

item.title: Women Making History: Francesca Mayca Wegner, leader of HPGM
item.description: Francesca Mayca Wegner holds the top spot at Hispanic Professionals of Greater Milwaukee (HPGM), but instead of CEO, she prefers the title "President and Chief Possibilities Officer." What a testament to who she is professionally and personally.

item.title: Chili Peppers' Chad Smith launches national music ed program in Milwaukee
item.description: Drummer Chad Smith's foundation announced on Wednesday that it is launching a nation-wide After-School Music Program (AMP) in an effort to make high-quality music education more accessible via after-school programming.

item.title: On the Burger Trail: The double cheeseburger at Walters' on North
item.description: Walters' on North is as classic as taverns come. But how about their burger? Let's find out.
